## Appearance

_Not yet known._

## Personality

Jane is a steady, sensible, and practical individual who is also described as nice, lady-like, and fond of the woods. Initially motivated to devote her entire life to teaching and never marry because teachers earn a salary, she aims to earn her pay fairly, please the trustees, and achieve a place on the School Inspector's roll of honor. She possesses great skill in cooking, though her husband does not allow her to do so.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P18](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0018), [v2 IV Different Opinions P2](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0002), [v2 IV Different Opinions P8](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0008), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P76](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0076), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P59](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0059), +1 more_

## History

Jane attended school and Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) alongside [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), and she had visited the [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition) twice prior to her studies. While at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) taking courses, she visited [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) at her boarding house along with [Josie](../character/josie-pye.md) and Ruby to share news about the Avery scholarship to [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). After finishing her studies, Jane joined [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) on a springtime walk to Hester Gray's garden, where they spent the afternoon discussing Hester's tragic life and enjoying nature. Over time, her family connection expanded as her brother [Billy Andrews](../character/billy-andrews.md) married, while she and [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md) remained topic of conversation among their friends in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P13](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P1](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P2](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P6](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P8](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P10](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0010), +304 more_

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--jane.md)

Jane and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) have been friends and companions since their school days. Jane visited [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) at her boarding house during their time at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) to share news about the Avery scholarship, and later joined [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) on a springtime walk to Hester Gray's garden to celebrate Anne's unofficial birthday.

### [Billy Andrews](../character/billy-andrews.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/billy-andrews--jane.md)

[Billy](../character/billy-andrews.md) is Jane's brother. Jane's peer group keeps track of major developments in his life, including his marriage, which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) learns about upon returning to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea).

- Sibling of — brother and sister  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P27](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0027), [v3 ch.Proposal P5](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0005), [v3 ch.Life P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000)</sub>

### [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/diana-barry--jane.md)

Jane and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) are long-standing friends and active members of the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) community. They participated in outings together, such as exploring the woods and Hester Gray's garden on Anne's unofficial birthday, and their mutual friend [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) frequently discusses them.

### [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/jane--ruby-gillis.md)

Jane and Ruby are old friends who belong to the same social circle in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). Their mutual friends maintain connections with both of them, even as Ruby faces a terminal illness.

- Friend of — old friends who get together (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P60](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0060)</sub>

### [Inglis](../character/inglis.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/inglis--jane.md)

[Inglis](../character/inglis.md) is a millionaire from Winnipeg who married Jane. Their marriage represents a major transition in Jane's life, separating her from her former circle of friends in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea).

- Spouse of — married millionaire from Winnipeg (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Weddings P27](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0027), [v3 ch.Time P9](../source/v03-c41.md#nw-v03-c41-p0009)</sub>

### [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/jane--priscilla-grant.md)

Jane and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) are friends who shared leisure time together in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). They notably went on a celebratory spring walk with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), spending the day exploring the woods and sharing lunch at Hester Gray's garden.

- Friend of — friends who discovered Hester Gray's garden together (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Time P16](../source/v03-c41.md#nw-v03-c41-p0016)</sub>
